item.description:
Aki 0.8.6

Fixed

  • A double-click on a Claude app or Codex app conversation's ring opens that conversation in the app, like an Orca tab.
  • The marks already with the agent ("1 to do") are always listed on the ring's card; a click opens that session's History, where you can see and resolve each one.

item.title: 0.8.6-beta.2
item.description:
Aki 0.8.6 beta 2

Fixed

  • A double-click on a Claude app or Codex app conversation's ring opens that conversation in the app, like an Orca tab.
  • The marks already with the agent ("1 to do") are always listed on the ring's card; a click opens that session's History.

Aki 0.8.5

New

  • Your conversations in the Claude app (chats) and the Codex app show in the sidebar, one ring each: marks sent to one open that conversation in the app and go in there. Those untouched for a day wait in "+N". Switch any off in Settings → Claude Code / Codex.

Fixed

  • The "+N" card no longer runs off the bottom of the screen with many sessions.

Aki 0.8.4

New

  • History → Sessions: your conversations of the last 7 days (Claude Code in a terminal or the Claude app, Codex), open or closed, with search. Open one to go there; resume a closed one in a new Orca tab. Also from the "+N": "This week's sessions…".

Fixed

  • The Claude app's Code sessions are found by their own process (the app writes no session record for them), so they now show on the sidebar.
